answers.sso-providers: Yes. Our platform supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on. We have out-of-the-box production integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Google Workspace, and OneLogin. Additionally, we support OpenID Connect for custom identity providers.
answers.scim: Yes. SCIM 2.0 user provisioning and de-provisioning is natively supported for Okta and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
answers.mfa-admins: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all administrative accounts on our platform. The supported factors are TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) and WebAuthn hardware keys.
answers.encryption-at-rest: All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM. Encryption keys are managed in AWS KMS, which handles automatic annual key rotation. For customers on the Enterprise plan, we offer customer-managed keys (BYOK) to provide direct control over key lifecycles. Further details regarding our cryptographic standards and key management procedures can be provided on request.
answers.tls: Our platform protects data in transit using TLS 1.3 as the default standard, while maintaining TLS 1.2 minimum support specifically for legacy clients. We explicitly disable all cipher suites below 128-bit and do not support legacy protocols including SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1. Specific details regarding cipher suite configurations or custom compliance requirements can be confirmed upon request.
answers.iso27001: Yes. We maintain ISO 27001:2022 certification. Our certificate number is NW-27001-2024, issued by BSI, and it remains valid through March 2027.
answers.soc2: Yes. We complete an annual SOC 2 Type II audit covering Security, Availability, and Confidentiality. The most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026. The full report is available to customers under a non-disclosure agreement.
answers.audit-log: Our platform writes every administrative and data-access event to an immutable audit log. This log is retained for 400 days. To integrate with your security infrastructure, audit logs can be exported via API, streamed directly to a customer SIEM over webhooks, or delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket.
answers.pentest: Yes. An independent third-party penetration test is performed annually by Cure53. The executive summary of the penetration test report is shared with customers on request.
answers.vuln-sla:
We maintain a rigorous vulnerability management lifecycle supported by continuous dependency scanning using Dependabot and Snyk, alongside static analysis executed on every pull request. Independent third-party penetration testing is performed annually by Cure53, with the executive summary made available to customers on request. 

For identified vulnerabilities, our engineering team enforces strict remediation SLAs based on severity: critical vulnerabilities are remediated within 7 days, high-severity vulnerabilities within 30 days, and medium-severity vulnerabilities within 90 days. Additional details regarding our vulnerability scanning infrastructure and remediation verification processes can be confirmed on request.
answers.tenant-isolation: Our platform enforces multi-tenant isolation at both the application and data layers. The application tier runs as stateless containers on Amazon EKS across three availability zones, fronted by an Application Load Balancer and AWS WAF. At the data layer, tenant isolation is strictly enforced through a mandatory `tenant_id` predicate applied within our ORM, which is subsequently re-checked by row-level security policies implemented in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 16. For customers with regulatory isolation requirements, a single-tenant dedicated deployment is available on the Enterprise plan. Additional technical specifications regarding our data store configuration and tenant boundaries can be confirmed on request.
answers.uptime-sla: Our contractual uptime commitment is 99.9% measured monthly for the Professional plan and 99.95% for目 the Enterprise plan, excluding scheduled maintenance announced five business days in advance. Service credits are awarded for uptime falling below these thresholds, structured as 10% of monthly fees for uptime below 99.9%, 25% below 99.5%, and 50% below 99.0%. For context, our measured availability over the trailing 12 months was 99.982%. Commitments for any additional tiers or custom requirements not detailed here can be confirmed upon request.
answers.service-credits: Our contractual uptime commitment is 99.9% measured monthly for the Professional plan and 99.95% for the Enterprise plan, excluding scheduled maintenance announced 5 business days in advance. If this commitment is missed, service credits are issued as a percentage of monthly fees based on measured availability: 10% for uptime below 99.9%, 25% below 99.5%, and 50% below 99.0%. Measured availability over the trailing 12 months was 99.982%. Additional details regarding credit application processes can be confirmed on request.
answers.rpo-rto: Our platform maintains a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 5 minutes, achieved through continuous WAL archiving to a secondary AWS region. The Recovery Time Objective (RTO) for a full regional failover is 4 hours. Backups are captured continuously with point-in-time recovery retained for 35 days, alongside monthly snapshots maintained for 12 months. Disaster recovery failover testing is conducted twice per year. The corresponding test report is available to Enterprise customers upon request.
answers.backups:
We execute continuous backups paired with point-in-time recovery capabilities retained for 35 days, supplemented by monthly snapshots maintained for 12 months. Our architecture achieves a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 5 minutes through continuous Write-Ahead Log (WAL) archiving to a secondary AWS region, and a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 4 hours for a full regional failover. 

Following contract termination, customer data is purged from production systems within 30 days, and all corresponding backup copies are completely removed within 90 days. A formal deletion certificate is issued upon request. Disaster recovery failover procedures are tested twice per year, with the resulting test reports available to Enterprise customers. Specific details concerning implementation mechanisms and supplementary disaster recovery configurations can be confirmed on request.
answers.api-auth-limits:
Our REST API is authenticated using OAuth 2.0 client credentials or scoped personal access tokens. The platform publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 specification, and we maintain client SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go. 

Rate limits are enforced per tenant based on the selected subscription plan. The Professional plan enforces a rate limit of 1,000 requests per minute, while the Enterprise plan allows up to 5,000 requests per minute. Additional API capacity can be provisioned through our consumption-based Platform API add-on, billed per 10,000 calls with volume discounts available above 50 million calls per year. 

Further details regarding custom scopes, token lifespans, or burst handling can be confirmed on request.
answers.integrations:
Our platform provides native, supported integrations for a range of common enterprise systems, designed to fit seamlessly into your existing toolchain without requiring custom code or manual effort. 

Administrators can configure these connectors directly from the administration console. Our currently available native integrations include Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, and ServiceNow. 

In addition to these out-of-the-box connectors, our open REST API covers 100% of user interface functionality, and outbound webhooks are available for 40 event types to support custom workflows and data flows. Additional details regarding integration scope and configuration can be confirmed on request.
answers.webhooks:
We provide outbound webhooks covering 40 event types to support real-time event streaming and automation. To secure communications and verify authenticity, every webhook delivery is signed using an HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated over the request body. Receiving systems can use this signature to cryptographically validate that the payload originated from our platform and has not been tampered with in transit. 

In the event of delivery failures, our platform automatically retries failed requests using an exponential backoff algorithm for up to 24 hours. Configuration of webhook endpoints is managed directly through our administration console. Further technical specifications regarding payload schemas and event types are detailed in our published OpenAPI 3.1 specification, and additional implementation documentation is available upon request.
answers.pricing-model:
Our platform operates on a straightforward and predictable named user subscription model, complemented by a consumption-based Platform API model priced per 10,000 API calls. 

We offer three main tiers with distinct minimum commitments:
- **Starter:** Requires a minimum of 5 seats on an annual contract.
- **Professional:** Requires a minimum of 25 seats on an annual or 3-year contract.
- **Enterprise:** Requires a minimum of 100 seats, with a 3-year term preferred.

Volume discounts apply as seat counts increase, and multi-year prepayments attract an additional 5% discount. Pricing is held flat for the committed term, with renewals capped at CPI or 4%, whichever is lower. Standard payment terms are net 30, with quarterly invoicing available on the Enterprise plan at no surcharge. Furthermore, the Enterprise plan includes no charge for read-only Auditor seats up to 10% of the paid seat count. Additional details regarding custom configurations and enterprise agreements can be confirmed on request.
answers.volume-discounts:
Our platform offers volume discounts based on seat count on our Professional and Enterprise subscription tiers. For the Enterprise plan, which has a minimum of 100 seats and a preferred 3-year contract term, a volume discount of 22% is applied at 500 seats, and 30% is applied at 1,000 seats. 

Additionally, multi-year prepayment attracts a further 5% discount across applicable plans. Pricing is held flat for the committed term, with any uplift at renewal capped at CPI or 4%, whichever is lower. Payment terms are net 30 from the invoice date, with annual invoicing standard and quarterly invoicing available on the Enterprise plan at no surcharge. Specific custom pricing structures beyond our published volume tiers can be discussed and confirmed upon request.
answers.payment-terms: Our standard payment terms are net 30 from the invoice date. Annual invoicing is standard across our plans, providing a predictable and straightforward billing cycle. Additionally, quarterly invoicing is available specifically on the Enterprise plan at no surcharge, offering greater flexibility to align with your internal financial processes. Multi-year prepayment attracts a further 5% discount, and pricing is held flat for the committed contract term with any uplift at renewal capped at the Consumer Price Index (CPI) or 4%, whichever is lower. All prices exclude applicable taxes. Further details regarding custom billing arrangements or specific procurement requirements can be confirmed on request.
answers.support-model:
Our platform is backed by a robust support model designed to ensure operational continuity and success. Standard support is included with every plan during business hours in your region, backed by a 4-hour first-response target. 

For organisations requiring continuous oversight, our Premium support tier provides comprehensive coverage 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. This tier includes a rapid 1-hour first-response target specifically for Severity 1 incidents, ensuring urgent issues receive immediate attention from our engineering teams. In addition, you are paired with a named Technical Account Manager who leads a monthly service review to monitor system health and strategic alignment. 

All of our support tiers include full access to our documentation portal, the public status page, and the community forum. Further details regarding incident management runbooks and escalation protocols can be provided upon request.
answers.implementation:
We guide mid-market customers through a structured, predictable implementation that typically takes 6 to 8 weeks. Every project is led by a named project manager and follows a proven four-phase methodology designed to ensure user adoption and rapid time-to-value. 

The journey begins with a 1-week discovery phase, followed by 3 to 4 weeks dedicated to system configuration and data migration. We then spend 2 weeks on integration and user acceptance testing, culminating in go-live and a 1-week hypercare period. To empower your internal teams for long-term success, our approach includes comprehensive administrator training alongside a dedicated train-the-trainer session tailored for your end-user champions. Following go-live, your account is transitioned to an assigned customer success manager who runs quarterly business reviews to track platform adoption and align on future roadmap enhancements.
answers.customer-success:
We believe in long-term partnerships and are measured directly on customer outcomes, adoption, and satisfaction from implementation through to ongoing operations. Following go-live, every account is assigned a dedicated Customer Success Manager who runs structured quarterly business reviews to ensure your teams derive continuous value from the platform. 

To measure and drive adoption proactively, we track usage on a shared dashboard covering licence utilisation, weekly active users, and feature depth. The quarterly business review agenda is built around these insights, incorporating a platform roadmap preview and an open review of enhancement requests so your feedback directly shapes our development. 

For ongoing operational support, Standard support is included with every plan, while Premium support adds a named Technical Account Manager who runs monthly service reviews alongside 24x7 coverage and a 1-hour first-response target for Severity 1 incidents. Details regarding additional support structures and custom adoption metrics can be confirmed on request.
answers.data-residency: Yes. Customer data can be hosted in AWS in one of three regions: eu-west-1 (Ireland), us-east-1 (N. Virginia), or ap-southeast-2 (Sydney). The region is selected at provisioning time, and data is never moved to another region without the customer's written instruction.

Additionally, our agreement includes a UK International Data Transfer Addendum for customers subject to UK GDPR. Specific documentation and agreement copies can be confirmed and provided on request.
answers.data-deletion: Yes. Following contract termination, customer data is deleted from our production systems within 30 days. In addition, copies held in our backups are completely purged within 90 days. Furthermore, a formal deletion certificate can be issued to you upon request.
